Priya Rao: Morning — quick heads up, my laptop courier is stuck in transit and I need badge access for Day 1 orientation. Also background check returned a minor employment gap flag (from 2021) that HR needs to clear. Can we run a contingency plan?
Alex Kim: Sorry to hear that, Priya. Which courier and ETA? I can request temporary badge escort if facilities can approve.
Priya Rao: Courier tracking says delayed until EOD, DHL tracking 1234XYZ. ETA now 8pm PST. I can join virtually but Miguel wants a brief in-person intro.
Sam Patel: I can ship a loaner from IT today if we have a confirmed desk pickup address. Do we have Priya's shipping address on file?
Priya Rao: Yes, it's 42 Maple St, Apt 3, Oakland.
Miguel Torres: I can do the intro remotely at 11am PT if escort not possible. If Priya can get into the building for badge pickup, that would be ideal for quick team photos.
Jamie Li: Facilities — we can meet at 10:30am at Main Lobby for a temporary escort badge, but we need HR approval for an exception on i9 remote verification (Priya is completing I-9 via kiosk at the kiosk partner). Who owns the exception?
Nora Singh: Security here. For temporary escort we require a signed visitor form + government ID check on arrival. If I-9 is pending, we can set a 4-hour escort window but we need HR to acknowledge risk.
Alex Kim: @Nora noted. @HR Bot can you log the I-9 remote exception and flag security approval?
HR Bot: New case created: I-9 Exception #HR-2026-089 for Priya Rao. Background gap flagged — notes requested. Assigned to Alex Kim.
Priya Rao: I have a previous employment letter I can upload. Will do that now.
Priya Rao: Uploaded letter.pdf to the onboarding portal.
Alex Kim: Got it, thanks. Background team — can you confirm whether the 2021 gap requires further investigation or is an explanatory note enough?
HR Bot: Background team notified. Typical turnaround 2 business days; priority set to high for Day 1 impact.
Sam Patel: I'll prepare a loaner laptop image with the Day 1 checklist + Zoom. ETA pickup window 2–4pm if Facilities can confirm someone at Dev Bay A for handoff.
Jamie Li: We can have coverage in Dev Bay A from 2–4. Please ensure visitor form is pre-signed and ID matches.
Nora Singh: Security will perform ID check at pickup and issue temporary badge (expires EOD). Escort staff assigned: Kelsey.
Miguel Torres: Thanks team. If the loaner works, we'll do the intro in-person 3pm. If not, remote stand-in at 11am. Priya — do you need benefits enrollment orientation? That can be scheduled Day 2 if you go remote Day 1.
Priya Rao: Benefits Day 2 is fine. Also relocation reimbursement packet needs signature — is that digital?
Alex Kim: Yes Priya — relocation form link sent via DocuSign earlier today. If you didn't get it I'll resend.
Priya Rao: Didn't see it, can you resend?
Alex Kim: Resent. Please sign and confirm.
Priya Rao: Signed.
HR Bot: DocuSign status: completed. Relocation packet uploaded to employee record.
Priya Rao: Quick Q: for payroll and tax forms, can I finish W-4 and direct deposit later today?
Alex Kim: Yes, finish those by EOD to avoid payroll delay. Payroll team is aware of potential Day 1 exceptions.
Sam Patel: Loaner prep done. Tracking for physical loaner pickup: handoff code \"REDWOOD-LOAN-772\".
Jamie Li: Facilities will post the handoff code at Dev Bay A and coordinate with Kelsey.
Nora Singh: Reminder for escort: no access to secure racks. If Priya needs server access, request IT VPN + RBAC after HR completes background clearance.
Miguel Torres: Noted. Priya — welcome again, sorry for the juggling. We'll keep Day 1 light: meet the team, benefits intro Day 2, quick security/IT checklist.
Priya Rao: Thanks everyone — appreciate the fast responses. See you at 2:15pm in Dev Bay A if the loaner arrives, otherwise I'll join 11am remotely. :slightly_smiling_face:
